$comment: Stage outputs of the intake rule (tool-evaluation-by-use §5b) for one owner-shared post. A: one self-scan acting as the resource (opus). B: two read-only confirmers (sonnet). C: the coordinating session's decision. Model output throughout: quoted by the intake row, never a fixture or a figure. The resource is a post with no source repository, so it was READ, not run; §4 and §5 do not apply.

proposals.what: Interview until the requirements are clear and write them as a playbook; keep what the agent produces as persistent rules; give the agent a built-in checklist of what done looks like. It claims this avoids multi-agent overhead of about 4x to 15x and that GitHub Spec Kit already implements it.
proposals.alreadyHere: Interview and specification skills exist (interview-me, grilling, grill-me, spec-driven-development, writing-plans, brainstorming); `ls .claude/skills | wc -l` printed 121 and `ls .claude/agents | wc -l` printed 15. A Stop hook (.claude/hooks/verify-done.sh, wired in .claude/settings.json) blocks a stop when loop:state fails, the tree is dirty, or HEAD is not on origin. GitHub Spec Kit already has an intake row dated 2026-09-23, adopted by reference with no files vendored.
trials: The 4x to 15x figure has no source in the post and nothing in the tree measures it; it is recorded as the post's claim.

`git grep -n -i "polling monitor\|one push per review\|review a head once" -- CLAUDE.md docs .claude` found 0 matches: the solo-versus-workflow rule and the credit-saving rules are not written in the shared tree.
The clause 'never repeats the same work' has no gate; it is aspirational.

tasks.title: Write a solo-versus-workflow rule and the credit-saving rules into .claude/WORKFLOWS.md
tasks.evidence: the grep above found 0 matches; WORKFLOWS.md 'When to run which' names only three passes
tasks.risk: WORKFLOWS.md says a change needs a decision record; the recorded default at the time was the opposite

tasks.title: Add the resource-intake row for this post
tasks.risk: low; must not quote the 4x to 15x figure as fact

votes.reason: The counts reproduce and no skill duplicates it, but docs/agent/LOOP.md recorded the owner's default as workflows, the opposite of the proposed rule; WORKFLOWS.md is a pass table and needs a decision record.
The Spec Kit row and the named skills and hook cover steps 1 and 3; mark the 'never repeats work' clause partial and the figure unverifiable.
The gap is real. Any solo rule must say it never waives a review stage a decision record requires, and that a self-check by the same agent is not independent review.
121 skills, 15 agents and the Stop hook reproduce; the figure must be marked as the post's unsourced claim.
